groups.name: Display
groups.note: Poppins for Latin and numerals, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for Arabic (the browser falls back per glyph). Weights 300–600; never bold. Arabic runs about 1.1× the Latin size.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Page titles, slide titles and dialog titles.

groups.note: Body 15px / 1.6 for Arabic. Hierarchy by size and color, not weight. Nothing is smaller than 13px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row sub-lines, badges, hints, small buttons. The smallest size.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Logs, hashes, versions and YAML. Always LTR.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Technical values: versions, hashes and logs.

radius.note: Containers tighten as they nest (16 → 12 → 8); controls use 10; pills are for avatars and dots.

tokens.name: radius-xs

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Slides, the command palette and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs and the search field.

tokens.name: radius-pill

shadow.note: No drop shadows under cards. Only overlays float.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The slide stack, toasts and the command palette over the backdrop.

layout.note: Shell: a 216px labelled menu (a bottom bar on phones), a top bar, one workspace and the slide stack.

tokens.name: layout-menu
tokens.usage: Side menu width. The slide stack starts beside it.

tokens.name: layout-bottombar
tokens.usage: Bottom bar height on phones. The slide stack stops above it.

tokens.name: layout-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: layout-panel
tokens.usage: Slide width on desktop (the slide stack).

tokens.name: layout-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling cards.

control.note: Control heights. Every button in a row shares one height.

tokens.name: control-btn
tokens.usage: Button and icon button height.

tokens.usage: Small button height, for rows and compact inputs.
